excerpts.finding: Visually read all V2iii1–4. No obvious body mismatch with current normalized source. The exhortation: no longer resent children nor abandon sister so they are cleansed; just discipline conditional on no resentment, resentment causes death. Household neglect and wicked business dealings. Not departing living God, simplicity and much self-control save, conditional on continuing; universal like-practice/innocence/simplicity, eternal life. All righteousness workers not destroyed forever. Maximus warning, denial again, Lord near returners, Eldad/Modat citation. Apparatus identifies arneisthai as Harmer conjecture [L,E]; arnesai reported S,A,L. This is morphology/grammar of DENY; do not misreport it as ask again.
